subject: reasoning
question: 8 women A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing opposite to the centre (not necessarily in the same order). B is second to the left of H. A is third to the left of B. D is to the immediate right of H. F is fourth to the left of D. C is the immediate neighbour of H and B. G is second to the right of H . Who are the immediate neighbours of F?
solution:
Given:

1. D is immediate right of H. G is second to the right of H. So D and G are placed clockwise from H.
